walkthroughs.body_html:
Scientists use proxies to study past climates:

• Ice cores from Antarctica — air bubbles reveal CO₂
• Tree rings — wider in warm/wet years
• Pollen records in peat bogs

Modern data shows unprecedented rapid warming.

Mitigation = reducing causes:

• Renewable energy (wind, solar, hydro)
• Carbon capture and storage
• Planting trees (afforestation)
• International agreements (Paris 2015)

Aim: net zero by 2050.

Adaptation = coping with effects:

• Flood defences (Thames Barrier)
• Drought-resistant crops
• Managed retreat from coasts
• Water management

Even with mitigation, some warming is locked.

mcqs.q: Which evidence source shows CO₂ levels going back 800,000 years?
options: Tree rings
Ice cores
Cave paintings
Weather forecasts

mcqs.q: Which is an example of climate change ADAPTATION?
options: Switching to solar power
Building flood defences
Carbon capture plants
Banning petrol cars

mcqs.q: What is the difference between mitigation and adaptation to climate change?
options: Mitigation and adaptation mean the same thing — both are about stopping climate change.
Mitigation reduces the causes (cutting greenhouse gas emissions); adaptation reduces the impacts (e.g. building sea walls, drought-resistant crops, early warning systems).
Mitigation is done by HICs and adaptation is done by LICs.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.

mcqs.q: What causes global sea level rise?
options: It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
Two main factors: thermal expansion of warming seawater, and the melting of land-based ice (glaciers and ice sheets) adding water to oceans.
Sea level rises mainly because Arctic sea ice is melting.
Sea level rises because of underwater volcanoes pushing it up.

mcqs.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: The strengthening of the natural greenhouse effect by human activities (mainly burning fossil fuels) which add CO2 and other gases to the atmosphere.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
Mitigation is done by HICs and adaptation is done by LICs.
The greenhouse effect is entirely man-made and harmful.
